entry: Accepted FT7.1b2b2a closure/certificate and immutable training/social prefixes; no accepted suite rerun
scope: Complete FT7.1b2b2 scoped retained reuse; FT7.1b2b3 integrated reserve/history feedback remains mandatory
policy: The original certificate conservatively retains the original permitted-support demand bound. Do not reinterpret it as an unsupported certificate.

Derive the stricter no-support demand by removing permitted support, preserving every other attribute. Execute two additional distinct paid uses and current-evidence Shell evaluations of the same retained content. Reuse the unchanged ledger continuity and certificate rules; derive a fresh certificate from actual independent training only after these exposures close.

Snapshot the exact closed/certified prefix. Only a new subsequently owned and paid need can enter later reuse. No evaluator-selected route, output, certificate, success or capacity is a runtime input.

Use the unchanged IntegratedDemandController, IntegratedRoutePolicy and native executor for later choice, movement, exact-output consumer and settlement. Applicable recalled evidence has the unchanged retained priority. Missing/revoked or out-of-bounds evidence removes that priority, not permanent closure history.

Positive later tasks use a novel target, changed contextual partner and no permitted support. Both settings, canonical SelectionEngine and explicit workflow v4. No native semantics, baseline, DIM, TIM, wallet default or accepted module changes.

Matched revocation must change retained choice to nonretained without changing the paid main route/consumer cost. Harder load and wrong cue must not claim applicability. Partial movement and consumer restart must be exact. Native reserve/history integration remains FT7.1b2b3 debt.
fixtures: New integrated cases construct owned training and closure under their unchanged accepted implementations. Independently supplied later paid need and initial personal stance/model opportunities name no route. New target is SAW2 in canonical and DEVICE in workflow; partner changes from BOB to EVE, permitted support becomes empty. Retract earlier needs through paid native binding. Revocation is a declared evidence ablation, not source or native-state mutation.
acceptance: 18 exact saved records roundtrip and independently audit full immutable prefixes and new effects
Exact public checkpoint and privately preserved evidence verified
failure_policy: Preserve every attempt; diagnose and prospectively register repair before re-freezing and bounded retry. No criterion weakening.
